title: Drupal Redesign
meta: A fresh, faster look for your existing Drupal site while content and page addresses stay in place. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Redesign your Drupal site and keep your content
overview: We give your Drupal site a new look without moving your content or changing page addresses. We review what you have, agree a design direction with you, then rebuild the home page, key page types and navigation in a new or updated theme on a staging site. You approve the preview, and then we launch it, so your articles, pages and links stay exactly where visitors and search engines expect them.

faq: No. A redesign changes how pages look, not where they live. We keep addresses, titles and descriptions the same unless you ask us to change them.
Do I need to supply a design?
No. We propose a direction using your logo, brand colors and sites you admire. If you already have designs, we build from them instead.
Will editors need to relearn anything?
Rarely. We keep your content types and editing screens as they are, so your team keeps working the way they do now. We note any change in a short guide.
Can you also upgrade Drupal in this project?
Not here. This service changes the front end only. A version upgrade is part of our migration service and can be added as a separate order.
